gloss_en: expert in running forward (baki be-ratzo) — the first of the two expertises in the ways of teshuvah in Likutey Moharan I:6: mastery of the ascent/advance ('If I ascend to heaven, You are there'), never standing still at any level attained but ever striving higher; identified with the Zohar's 'entering' (ayil) and the segol of Ekyeh spelled out to 161 (KSA)
